header: Three shippers, three delivery problems solved

cases.summary: Chilled groceries now leave Oslo at 21:00 and reach 34 stores before opening. The retailer cut its own night fleet from 12 trucks to 4.
Parts reach the line at Wolfsburg in four fixed windows a day, so the plant no longer keeps a 5,000-unit buffer at the gate.
Bonded loads clear customs in 41 minutes on average. Before the Eindhoven depot took over the paperwork, the same lane lost a whole afternoon.
